descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper noun (אֵלָה II) referring to several biblical persons, including a king of Israel son of Baasha, a valley name (the Valley of Elah where David fought Goliath), a chief of Edom, and a father of certain officials. Rendered as 'Elah / Elá' (eng/spa), 'एलाह / एला' (hin), 'إِيلَةَ / إيلَة' (arb), '엘라' (kor), 'Ela' (swa). The two clusters are the same name; the second is merely the conjunctive form וְ + אֵלָה ('and Elah').
